created_time_note: Draft creation timestamp; root must set exact freeze timestamp in a separately frozen protocol before execution.
hypothesis: Nearby approved known valve/time/phase traces within the same lung setting may supply useful training-neighbor pressure context. This diagnostic checks only one simple estimator against a training-pool-only RC/position baseline.
provenance: Independent implementation inspired by the user-supplied S06 synthesis in kagglediscussion.md. No external solution code, original Kaggle data, pretrained solution or unrelated data.

recipe.distance: Euclidean RMS of all240 standardized entries of the complete80-step three-channel trace; equal channel/step weights; sameR/C pool only
recipe.standardization: One global mean and population std per input channel, fitted on pool rows only; zero std replaced by1; no target or query statistics
recipe.phase_handling: Known binary u_out enters distance as a standardized input channel; no exact-mask restriction or query exclusion. Score query u_out==0 only; report retrieved-neighbor phase mismatch.
recipe.prediction: Coordinatewise median of the five retrieved pool pressure curves
recipe.baseline: Pool-only median pressure for eachR/C and position using pool u_out==0 rows; empty cells fall back to thatR/C pool inspiratory median
recipe.target_dtype: float32 parsed only for originalAfit breaths; errors and aggregate scores float64
recipe.input_dtype: float64, parsed only for originalAfit breaths
recipe.ties: Stable sort by squared distance; exact ties retain canonical pool row order. Neither IDs nor pressures are passed to retrieval.
recipe.bootstrap_unit: Whole query breath, point-weighted native inspiratory MAE difference, KNN minus baseline

statistics_pools: Only Afit excluding all576 query breaths. Original Aval excluded from every scientific calculation; its IDs are checked only for exclusion. CSV is streamed, but non-fit rows are skipped before any input/target conversion.
selection: No k, feature, weight, mask, baseline, cutoff or model tuning from these outcomes; exactly one recipe. No automatic GPU promotion and no pressure-MAE target gate.
interpretation: An inner Afit diagnostic cannot establish benefit over the LSTM, grouped A, cold F or the official score. Favorable results justify considering a separately frozen cross-fitted neighbor-residual model, not claiming a model improvement.
future_residual_context_requirements: Train-query neighbor features must be cross-fitted inside the training fold, with query/self labels excluded.
Original A-validation lookup pools must contain only Afit breaths.
Cold F confirmation must rebuild features, scalers and neighbor pools on Ffit only; no original A model reuse.
Final all-approved fitting may use all approved labeled breaths only after validation selection.
Keep existing official result and never use hidden scores to select neighbor parameters.
execution_status: No diagnostic, inference, GPU work, distance, score, outcome or approved-data fit has been executed.
outputs: outputs/neighbors_feasibility_v027 (must not exist before execution); design/sample-before-scoring, predictions, retrieval identities/distances, disagreement arrays, per-query/per-RC CSVs, correlations, paired whole-breath bootstrap and immutable summary with hashes
primary_comparison_metric: native inspiratory point-weighted mean MAE only; other metrics descriptive
weak_baseline_limitation: Improvement over a simple R/C-position median cannot establish improvement beyond the LSTM or trigger GPU fitting; no automatic promotion.
required_preflight: Synthetic fake-query-label mutation must leave retrieval, scaler and both predictions unchanged while changing scoring. Pool-pressure mutation must leave retrieval unchanged and change predictions. Defined but not executed in draft.
required_diagnostics: Per-R/C mean full-breath and inspiratory neighbor phase-mismatch fraction
Neighbor pressure MAD and IQR as disagreement, not calibrated uncertainty
Control distance and disagreement relationships to held-out inner-query native errors
Per-R/C MAE, point counts and total absolute-error contribution
One paired whole-breath bootstrap versus simple baseline; no additional estimator/weight search
